evidence.title: Spiking Neural Networks for Continuous Control: Neuromorphic Reinforcement Learning in Conventional Computing

summary: Researchers demonstrate the use of spiking neural networks (SNNs) to achieve neuromorphic reinforcement learning on conventional computing hardware, advancing AI for continuous control tasks. The approach bridges biological plausibility with practical applications in robotics and adaptive systems.
title: Spiking Neural Networks Enable Neuromorphic Reinforcement Learning for Continuous Control
